Charge me a fee
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and attempted to cancel within the week, but I was unable to do so. I have proof that this charge is unrelated to my application, but I have been unable to contact anyone for assistance

reviews.title: Very disappointing and not worth the subscription
reviews.text: It doesn't allow copy paste and I won't go in detail because of this but this app it's the cause of many of my plants death and its weather recommendations are most of the time inaccurate.

reviews.title: Used to like it, not worth paying for
reviews.text: I used to use the free version of Planta. Just got a new phone and despite all the rest of my data transferring over just fine, none of my data from Planta transferred, it couldn’t find my account despite trying multiple methods, and I suddenly was told I’d have to start paying for it. While there are aspects of this app I have enjoyed, the watering schedule is really not right and in my opinion it’s not worth paying for. The free version was fine for my needs, but if that’s no longer available beyond the very short free trial, I’m not interested in continuing to use it.

reviews.title: Beware subscription cancellation and it still charges you
reviews.text: I have canceled my subscription, but the app continues to try and charge me monthly.

reviews.title: Overwatering app
reviews.text: Stuck with this expensive app, still lots of issues with it. Always prompting to overwater or overfeed. Doesn’t take into consideration the climate in which you live in.

reviews.title: hidden cancellation
reviews.text: Any app or subscription that purposely hides their cancellation option shouldn’t be in business, it’s extremely predatory. If it was such a great app then it should be easy to pause/cancel/restart subscription at any time without jumping through hoops to access your own account information. The app itself is fine but absolutely not worth the price, I barely used it as it was pretty laggy.

reviews.title: Just use ChatGPT
reviews.text: Hard to backdate watering information, gives initially awful advice for some plants - if I’d followed it, a third of my plants would be dead.  It appears to mostly be a poorly designed reminder app, and one that offers in-app purchases to boot.

reviews.title: Keeps charging me after ending subscription.
reviews.text:
DON’T DOWNLOAD THIS APP! 

I got sucked in and it is not accurate at all with my plants. Doesn’t identify them right and I have to manually put in all the info because it has no idea. This is typical AI though. The biggest deal is it’s trying to charge my account over $52 over and over. I have canceled the subscription but it doesn’t matter. It keeps trying to charge me. 

I know how to cancel my subscription’s and it even says it’s canceled but it doesn’t matter it is still trying to charge me. 

Don’t download this!

1. Not worth it
2. It won’t cancel and will keep charging you!

As a response to the Planta representatives that responded…

I did contact Planta, they made me contact Apple and Apple finally refunded me and stopped the service. This was a ton of hoops to jump through. My rating still stands thank you!

reviews.title: Price gouging
reviews.text: I hate that I paid a year subscription that was over $65 dollars (I didn’t mean to buy but couldn’t get a refund on) so I’ve been trying to use the app so I don’t feel like I wasted money. My problem is they’re wanting me to fork over another payment when I tried to take a picture of my plant to use the AI generated sick plant thing. I’m frustrated and I feel like this app does not give a darn about us plant parents. After the subscription is done, I would ban the app if I could…

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: App does not identify plants correctly number 1 number 2 it will have u over watering your plants needs a lot of development for this app still far from being good

reviews.title: WATERING AMOUNTS
reviews.text: The fact that all of these plant apps want to provide all of this extra information but leave out crucial information such as watering amounts. I have the app telling me “keep watering until this” or “pour water until that”. This is half-assery foreal. Waste of my time, so thank you for all the non legits reviews this app has. It should not be listed as a primary plant care app.

reviews.title: AI Junk
reviews.text: I thought I signed up for the free trail but it charged me $43 off the bat. First plant I scanned it labeled wrong. I got it for the disease function but the AI chat bot throws out a whole slew of possible illnesses and won’t tell you anything more than you could figure out yourself on Google or Reddit. Junk! I want my money back!

reviews.title: Pointless App.
reviews.text: Being perfectly honest, you can find all the information you need to care for your plants online. This app is completely unnecessary. Not a fan of the interface. Careful of the rolling subscription.

reviews.title: It works sometimes
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for about to years because I never had plants before. I have successfully grown some plants but I also killed many others because I followed the app watering days and I overwatered them.  When I noticed so many plants dying, I google (using AI) the recomendaron and they were too off from the app. For example this app got me watering my rosemary daily when it should be only once a week… some with my roses! My geraniums died, my flamingo lilies died, my petunias died and even some of my succulents died.  The most successful plants are the indoor ones, like my pothos and elephant ears.

reviews.title: Biggest scam
reviews.text: Don’t download it unless you are 100% sure that you want it. I canceled it at the end of the day of downloading it. And it charged me for a year subscription a week later. I was aware it would do that when I installed it. They make it really hard to contact them.

reviews.title: Spammy pop-ups have made this app unusable
reviews.text: Not sure what happened to the previous review I wrote about this. I’ve been a Premium subscriber for years now. Recently, there are now pop-ups advertising that I can refer a friend to get free Premium. The pop-up happens every time I water a plant. I have to close the pop-up to be able to mark the plant watered. I have dozens of plants. You can see how annoying this must be. If this continues, I will no longer be a Premium subscriber and will find some other solution. Sadly, it seems in line with Planta now focusing more on selling things and advertising what they sell, which didn’t exist when I first got the app. I already pay $36/year, but Planta seems mostly geared toward making more money lately.

reviews.title: Completely inaccurate
reviews.text: After so many positive reviews, I was shocked that the app could not even correctly identify my plants (I knew what they were). It misidentified most plants, including calling 2 completely different plants the same thing. It also diagnosed several obviously struggling plants as “healthy.” Completely unhelpful, not to mention that it said “7 days free,” and then charged me on day one. I canceled and requested a refund.

reviews.title: missed two out of three
reviews.text: I had an identify three plants in my backyard. It got ALO correct which is pretty damn easy. But it called my lime tree, lemon tree and called my starfruit tree a Thai curry tree. Seriously?

reviews.title: Week Trial…
reviews.text: The free week trial for the app to ‘test’ it out is not great. There is nothing you can use on the app  because it will just take you right back to the subscription purchase pop up. What’s the point of testing this out free for a week when you can’t even use the app?! What a joke.

reviews.title: Abusive freemium UX
reviews.text:
Most basic features are locked behind paywalls. The few “free” features are littered with ads, including frequent popup ads that require multiple steps to dismiss.

Premium offers horrendous value- if you don’t shell out monthly for basic features, you are subject to everything described above.

Recommend using any of the free or paid alternatives that respect your time and money.

reviews.text: Did it occur to Planta’s developers that gardeners might not want AI slop in their app? I’ve canceled my paid subscription.

reviews.title: Stole Cash from my Apple Wallet
reviews.text: I’ve got the free trial and after a few days, didn’t like the app so when the trail ended I clicked cancel to paying for the subscription and deleted the app. The next day they take about 46 or 50$ out of my account WITHOUT my permission. This is considered stealing and I didn’t get my money back at all. I told apple support i didn’t not authorize or make that payment however they cannot help. This app is AWFUL and steals your money. Don’t download

reviews.title: I lost at least 100 plants because of the app
reviews.text: I’ve lost a lot of plants because you changed the fertilizer option to include watering and I didn’t realize that.  Before it was just a reminder to fertilize without the option to turn that feature off, so would just mark them as done from the group setting so that I didn’t have to go through all of them to mark as done which added a lot of time to the watering time. I lost at least a 100 plants, one of my prized possessions a huge rope plant.  The reason I use this app is because it helps me manage my collection.  I thought something in my environment had changed, but it was the app.  You need to include options to turn off features for more experienced plant parents.  The objective for people with large collections is to minimize the time to take care of the plants.

reviews.title: Do you wanna kill your plants while also caring for plants ?
reviews.text: Great until they unnecessarily integrated A.I. Have a hard time believing your building a community of  real plant lovers when the basis of the app directly kills the envious.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Feel like I wasted my money. My plants are thriving only because of google searches and other AI's that can actually diagnose then compare progress over time.

reviews.title: Wtf is with no real customer service these days!
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to contact someone about being charged for a canceled subscription that Apple won’t refund because it’s in a pending status and has been for over a month! I canceled a free trial and never used the app anyhow, hut the day I canceled it (which was the last day to do so) you charged me anyways! And now I can’t download an app I have to have to a class I’m taking! Unfortunately you all only use chat bots and false promises of email contact!

reviews.title: So Many Spam Emails!
reviews.text: As soon as I downloaded this app and put in my email address to sign up, I was immediately inundated with spam emails. Within about two hours of downloading the app, I received over 200 emails asking me to click links and verify codes and such. When I canceled my subscription and deleted the app, the emails immediately stopped. What in the world??

reviews.title: MORE AI BS I NEITHER NEED NOR WANT
reviews.text: Worked well enough for a while, but then they added “AI” (plagiarism machine) bs and it’s been downhill ever since. I just want something that will remind me to water my plants, I don’t particularly relish using an app that contributes to the “ai” (plagiarism machine) plague currently destroying both our habitats.

reviews.title: All plants incorrectly identified!
reviews.text: It looked good but I put in 12 of my plants and it identified every one wrongly! Also said my plants were 2 years old when they are more like 2-4 months old!

reviews.title: Charged after saying Free Trial
reviews.text: The app prompted me to sign up for Dr Diagnose to check problems with my plant. It said 7 day free trial but I was charged the full amount for the week as soon as I hit subscribe. No free trial was provided. There is no way in the app to contact for refund. On top of that their Dr Diagnose does nothing ! I could do better with Gemini and ChatGPT for free !! I seriously want my £10 back ! Thai is fraud honestly.
